packageRules.description: iso/raw's BUILDER_IMAGE compiles gnome-setup and systemd-sysinstall that then run on the Hummingbird image, so its glibc must not be newer than Hummingbird's. Fedora 46 linked GLIBC_2.45 and the medium failed (#1499: /usr/bin/gnome-setup: version 'GLIBC_2.45' not found). Stay on the proven Fedora 43 major; its digest updates still flow. Raise this only with an E2E pass on the new major.
Red Hat Hardened Images pins (registry.access.redhat.com/hi), extracted from Containerfile ARGs by the built-in Dockerfile manager. They rebuild daily; take the digest weekly.

These 11 workflows are human-merge paths in the hive (they build, test, release or publish, or hold the App key). Give their updates their own branches, so a pin-only update to them is a PR of its own that the hive's pin-only exception can merge, instead of being held with other workflows. Renovate doesn't merge these updates itself, because its own merge would skip the hive's hold on these files. The hive merges a pin-only update (including the projectbluefin/testsuite test_ref lines that move with their uses: pin), and anything else, a major included, waits for a person. Keep this list equal to the hive's human_merge_paths for utah.
